question: Tell me about trial NCT02339571: what does it test and who sponsors it?

route.reason: The question asks for the study purpose and sponsor of a specific ClinicalTrials.gov registry record (NCT02339571), which is answerable from the trial registry alone.

draft.text: NCT02339571 is a Phase II/III trial titled "A Phase II/III Trial of Nivolumab, Ipilimumab, and GM-CSF in Patients With Advanced Melanoma" [trial:NCT02339571]. It is a randomized study comparing nivolumab plus ipilimumab plus sargramostim versus nivolumab plus ipilimumab in patients with unresectable Stage III or Stage IV melanoma [trial:NCT02339571]. It looks at side effects and how well the treatment works, and it is not yet known whether nivolumab and ipilimumab are more effective with or without sargramostim [trial:NCT02339571]. The primary outcome is overall survival [trial:NCT02339571]. The sponsor is the National Cancer Institute (NCI) [trial:NCT02339571]. Status is ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, with an enrollment of 600 and a start date of 2015-11-23 [trial:NCT02339571].
